purpose: Rebuild and fully qualify all three C08 trajectories with mesh-derived floor-following z and only necessary smooth S10 lateral corrections before causal topology replay.

approval.scope: One complete 4773-frame C08 floor-following trajectory corrective and clearance/continuity audit; zero training, inference, graph, C09/C10/M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after receiving the exact complete 4773-frame floor-following plus smooth lateral corrective proposal.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local read-only research reuse of sealed generated assets.

sampling.rule: Preserve all original route arcs and frame indices. Solve each sensor z from the sealed mesh floor. For S10 only, use nearest common feasible x/y cells for four physical failure groups and a fixed 10m C1 compact-support spatial blend; outside support lateral correction is exactly zero.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher. Mesh first hits define floor z and horizontal/up/down safety evidence.
teacher.valid_mask: Every corrected frame must have horizontal>=0.8m, down in [0.95,1.05]m, up>=0.8m; maximum adjacent lateral correction delta<=0.1m and corrected maximum step/turn may not exceed frozen trajectory by more than 0.1m/1deg.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Writes corrected trajectory assets only; no model or planner consumes them in this run.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only three C08 trajectories/meshes and approved C08 local diagnostic are read; C09/C10/M-TARE remain unread.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D: 3436560 horizontal plus 14319 vertical rays; zero GPU.

evidence.machine_metrics: Three corrected trajectory NPZs, 4773-row audit CSV and per-world continuity/clearance metrics.
evidence.complete_visual_review: One complete XY, horizontal and vertical audit figure per world.
evidence.failure_policy: Any failed frame, continuity regression, hash/count drift or forbidden read makes the run FAIL; no in-run parameter adjustment.
